description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' for logging purposes within an Android project. It acts as a wrapper around Android's native Log class, allowing for configurable logging nodes and different log levels, and provides static methods for logging messages and exceptions.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for logging. It wraps around Android's native logging mechanism and supports chaining of LogNode objects for advanced logging configurations.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the logging chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and throwable to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message with VERBOSE priority.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message with DEBUG priority.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message with INFO priority.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message with WARN priority.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message with ERROR priority.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message with ASSERT priority.
